settings.across.title: Across repositories
settings.across.body: Whether agents outside a repository read its checkout: sessions in its workspace's other repositories, and Ask Daoris. They read its files and `git status` and the branch list, and write nothing there. Reading is on unless it is switched off, for a workspace here or for a repository on its Setup, a repository's own setting over its workspace's. Writing into another repository is off, except where you declare it on a repository's Setup: that declaration is your standing say-so, in one direction. Also `daoris driver across`: the same file.
settings.across.none: No repository on this machine yet.
settings.across.workspaceHint: For each checkout in this workspace that sets none of its own.
settings.across.readBy: Read by sessions in {{workspace}} and by Ask Daoris, never written.
settings.across.readByNone: Read by no agent outside it.
settings.across.writesNone: Its sessions write into no other repository.
settings.across.savedOn: {{name}}: its checkout is read by agents outside it. A session already running keeps what it began with.
settings.across.savedOff: {{name}}: its checkout is read by no agent outside it. A session already running keeps what it began with.
settings.across.cleared: {{name}} takes its reading from what stands above it again.
settings.across.declared: Sessions in {{repository}} may also write into {{to}}: your say-so, in one direction.
settings.across.withdrawn: Sessions in {{repository}} no longer write into {{to}}; a change needed there is a quest again.
